title: TCL 55EP640, Greece (ro.product.model BeyondTV, board RTD2851 / platform rtd285o), Android TV 11 (API 30),
header:
TCL 55EP640, Greece (ro.product.model BeyondTV, board RTD2851 / platform rtd285o), Android TV 11 (API 30),
build PPR1.180610.011 AR04, fingerprint TCL/BeyondTV/BeyondTV:11/PPR1.180610.011/AR04, 32-bit (armeabi-v7a).
Same hardware as examples/tcl-50p615 (AR05) and the same package set, plus com.tcl.dashboard (TCL IoT
dashboard / giftbox promos, disabled as on examples/tcl-43p615).

Apply:   TV_HOST=<tv ip> tools/disable.sh examples/tcl-55ep640/debloat.txt
Undo:    TV_HOST=<tv ip> tools/restore.sh examples/tcl-55ep640/debloat.txt
Install the launcher BEFORE disabling the stock launcher (launcher/build-and-install.sh).
Stock launcher: com.google.android.tvlauncher. Other HOME claimants are only fallbacks:
com.tcl.keycustomfunctionservice/.FallbackHome and com.android.tv.settings FallbackHome.
One saved Wi-Fi network belongs to com.google.android.tungsten.setupwraith: leave it enabled (it is not
in this list), or forget and re-join that network in Settings first.
Live TV app: com.tcl.tv. Tuner and HDMI: com.tcl.tvinput (never disable either).

Already disabled when we started, left alone: the 14 uk.co.freeview.* apps, au.com.stan.and,
com.tcl.gallery, com.tcl.notereminder, com.tcl.smartalexa, tv.wuaki.apptv,
com.google.android.apps.nbu.smartconnect.tv, com.google.android.videos, com.google.android.play.games.

Tested 2026-10-21 on a real unit: applied in five batches with a screenshot after each (29/29 disabled at first,
plus the stock launcher via launcher/build-and-install.sh), then rebooted once: nothing came back
enabled. After the changes the launcher's Inputs menu (HDMI 1-3, AV, Live TV via TvInputManager; Live TV
opens com.tcl.tv/.TVActivity), Wi-Fi, and every button on the real remote (Home, Input, Settings, app
buttons, Back) worked. Not yet lived with for days.

DO NOT DISABLE (load-bearing on this firmware):
com.tcl.tv com.tcl.tvinput                          # Live TV, tuner, HDMI
com.tcl.keycustomfunctionservice                    # remote key handling, fallback home
com.tcl.inputmethod.international                   # default keyboard
com.tcl.settings com.tcl.initsetup com.tcl.factory.view com.tcl.providers.config
com.tcl.xian.StartandroidService                    # device authentication
com.tcl.partnercustomizer                           # carries the remote's TKey activity
com.tcl.systemserver com.tcl.autopair               # system service, BT remote pairing
com.tvos                                            # tvos framework resources
com.google.android.tungsten.setupwraith             # owns a saved Wi-Fi network on this unit
com.google.android.apps.mediashell                  # Chromecast (kept by choice)
com.tcl.miracast com.tcl.MultiScreenInteraction_TV  # Miracast / MagiConnect (kept by choice)
com.tcl.versionUpdateApp                            # TCL OTA updater (kept by choice)
com.google.android.tv.remote.service                # Google TV phone-app remote (kept by choice;
# disabled at first, re-enabled the same day)
